turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm tweaking the voice-loop config. I think I'll stick with a 3-turn consolidation loop for now since the latency is low.
Understood. A 3-turn loop is a safe bet for responsiveness.
Yeah. Also, did the package for the new mechanical switches arrive? I need to replace the clacking keys on my board.
I don't have access to your shipping notifications, but I can help you track it if you provide the carrier info.
Never mind, I'll check the app. Just wanted to confirm the voice-loop setting before I commit the change.
Confirmed: 3-turn consolidation loop is your current preference.
Lloyd, I was wrong about the earlier setting. The 3-turn loop was causing memory drift in voice-loop. I need to change it to a 5-turn consolidation loop for memory system updates to MEMORY.md.
Got it. I've noted that voice-loop now uses a 5-turn consolidation loop.
Great. Is it going to rain later? I want to know if I should bring the umbrella to the hardware store.
The forecast shows a high chance of precipitation after 4 PM.
Okay, I'll take it. Just double-checking the config so I don't push the wrong value.
